# Jess Cummings — Product Designer

> Jess Cummings is a product designer in Detroit, Michigan, who designs complex B2B systems: information architecture, design systems and the screens on top. She translates between business and engineering teams. University of Michigan School of Information graduate (B.S. Information Science, 2025). Open to full-time product design roles and select freelance.

## At a glance

- Role: Product designer (UX research, information architecture, UI, design systems, accessibility)
- Location: Detroit, MI, USA
- Education: University of Michigan, B.S. Information Science (2025)
- Contact: jessicacummings2021@gmail.com

## Case studies (each has its own page; all are stations on https://jesscummingsportfolio.com/)

- TripSlip (https://jesscummingsportfolio.com/work/tripslip) — Product designer, June 2026 to present. One field trip, four sides to design for: schools, parents, venues and bus companies each get their own view. Working with the product owner, Jess built the information architecture, a developer spec, the UI kit and 140+ screens.
- Bridgestone (https://jesscummingsportfolio.com/work/bridgestone) — Senior capstone, Best UX Prototype at UMSI 2025. Fleet managers juggled several tire-health tools; a five-person student team researched, prototyped and tested one platform with views by role. Jess was the project manager.
- Motmot (https://jesscummingsportfolio.com/work/motmot) — UX and product designer, Oct 2025 to May 2026. Redesigned a water-tech startup's existing Webflow site around one clear story, then measured it: pages per session up 88% in the first week.
- ConStrat AI (https://jesscummingsportfolio.com/work/constrat) — Product designer, Sept 2026 to present. Customer interviews to find where people stall in the engagement flow, and the design changes to fix it. (Password-protected.)
- B2B AI startup (anonymized) (https://jesscummingsportfolio.com/work/ai-startup) — Contract product designer, fall 2026. Audited the design system and built a design-to-production process the team adopted.
